notFound.heading: Environment not found
notFound.body: It doesn't exist, or it was removed.

smallSubnets.description: Give the networks your stacks create a smaller subnet than Docker's default, so the pool lasts longer. This applies when a stack creates a network for the first time and its compose file has no ipam block. Existing networks and your compose files are never changed.
smallSubnets.switch: Use smaller subnets for new stack networks
smallSubnets.room_one: The pool has room for about {{count, number}} more network of this size.
smallSubnets.room_other: The pool has room for about {{count, number}} more networks of this size.

settingsConflict.message: {{user}} changed these settings while you were editing. Reload to see them.
settingsConflict.messageAnon: These settings changed while you were editing. Reload to see them.

addressPools.description: Optional. Coaming reads the address pools the daemon reports, or Docker's defaults when daemon.json sets none. Enter pools here only if Coaming should measure against different ones.
addressPools.sizeHelper: Size is the mask each network gets, for example 24 for a /24.
addressPools.emptyBody: Coaming reads the address pools the daemon reports, or Docker's defaults when it sets none. Add pools here only to measure against different ones.

token.body: The join token lets a host enrol into this environment. It stays valid until you rotate or disable it. Enrolled agents keep working when it changes.
token.disabledBody: The join token is disabled. Show install command generates a new one.

disableConfirm.title: Disable the join token?
disableConfirm.body: No new host can enrol until you generate a new token with Show install command. Enrolled agents aren't affected.

badges.readOnlyTip: COAMING_AGENT_READ_ONLY is set on this host. The agent refuses every change Coaming asks for.

revoke.title: Revoke {{node}}?
revoke.body: {{node}} is disconnected now and its certificate is rejected for good. It can't enrol again until you unblock it. If the host itself may be compromised, also rotate the join token.
revoke.alreadyRevoked: That node was revoked while you were looking at it.
revoke.failed: Couldn't revoke the node. Try again.

unblock.title: Unblock {{node}}?
unblock.body: {{node}} can enrol again with the join token. The agent that was revoked isn't revived. If the host's agent still has its join token, it enrols again by itself within a minute. If not, install the agent on the host again.
unblock.failed: Couldn't unblock the node. Try again.

adopt.title: Adopt the new cluster?
adopt.body: {{name}} will be bound to the swarm that now reports cluster ID {{id}}. This is recorded in the audit log.
adopt.bodyNoId: {{name}} will be bound to the swarm that now reports a new cluster ID. This is recorded in the audit log.
adopt.noChange: There is nothing left to adopt. Another admin may have adopted it already.
adopt.inUse: Another environment already manages that cluster, so this one can't adopt it.
adopt.failed: Couldn't adopt the new cluster. Try again.

fold.title: Local host
fold.alert: This Coaming host is a manager of {{swarm}}. It can be reached through the Docker socket, so it needs no agent.
fold.body: Coaming will reach this node through the socket, and the separate Local socket environment is retired. Nothing changes on the host. This is recorded in the audit log.
fold.done: {{swarm}} now reaches this host through the Docker socket.
fold.notOffered: This host is no longer a manager of that swarm, or it was folded a moment ago. Nothing was changed.
fold.failed: Couldn't fold this host. Try again.

updates.autoHelper: After a Coaming upgrade, agents here are updated within the compatibility window. Turn this off to update them yourself.
updates.autoFailed: Couldn't change the setting. Try again.
updates.swarmNote: In a swarm one update rolls every node's agent, one after the other, so Update agent on one node updates them all.
updates.manualOff: Self-update is turned off on {{node}}. Update it by hand:
updates.manualOther: Coaming can't update {{node}} by itself. Update it by hand:

updateReasons.image_not_own_repository: the update image isn't from the agent's own repository
updateReasons.image_invalid: the update image isn't a valid reference
updateReasons.not_a_manager: a worker can't update the swarm's agent service
updateReasons.busy: another update is already running on that host
updateReasons.own_container_unknown: the agent couldn't identify its own container
updateReasons.update_failed: Docker refused the update (see the agent's log)
updateReasons.not_implemented: this agent is too old to update itself
updateReasons.insecure_session: the agent's connection isn't TLS-verified, so it won't update itself
updateReasons.no_answer: the agent didn't answer, so it can't update itself
updateReasons.no_new_version: the agent never came back on the new version
updateReasons.rolled_back: the new version didn't connect, so the old one was put back

updateErrors.agent_offline: That agent isn't connected, so it can't be told to update. Update it by hand, or wait until it is back.
updateErrors.no_manager_connected: No manager of this swarm is connected, and a swarm's agents are updated through a manager.
updateErrors.self_update_disabled: The owner of that host turned agent self-update off. Update it by hand.
updateErrors.agent_up_to_date: That agent already runs this server's version.
updateErrors.failed: Couldn't start the update. Try again.

remove.cardBody: Coaming stops managing this environment, revokes every agent and disables the join token. You can also have it uninstall the agent from the hosts.
remove.cardBodyLocal: Coaming stops managing this host. Nothing on it is changed.
remove.title: Remove {{name}}?
remove.body: Coaming will stop managing this environment and revoke every agent and the join token. Containers, images, volumes and networks on the hosts are not changed.
remove.uninstall: Also uninstall the agent from the hosts
remove.helperSome: {{online}} of {{total}} agents are online. The others need the manual command below.
remove.helperNone: No agents are online. Use the manual command below.
remove.helperUnknown: Couldn't tell which agents are online. Use the manual command below.
remove.waiting: Telling the agents to uninstall. This can take up to 30 seconds.
remove.manualBody: If an agent is offline, or you leave the box unchecked, run this on each host:
remove.failed: Couldn't remove the environment. Try again.

unknownAgents.title: Agents Coaming doesn't know
unknownAgents.body: These agents were installed after the backup was taken, so this Coaming refused them. Reinstall each one with its environment's install command.
